chunks.text:
Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Returns & Refunds Policy > 1. Return window
- Most items can be returned within **30 days of the delivery date**.
- **How the 30 days are counted:** the delivery date is **day 1**. The window ends at 11:59 PM PT on **day 30** (60 for Plus).
- Items must be unused, with original tags attached.
- **Northpeak Plus members** get a **60-day** return window.
- Items bought between **Nov 15 and Dec 31** can be returned until **Jan 31** of the next year, or within the normal window, whichever is later.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Returns & Refunds Policy > 7. Damaged or wrong items
- Report damaged or wrong items within **14 days of delivery**, with at least **one photo**. This applies to **all items, including Final Sale**.
- These get a full refund **including original shipping**, and no return fee. Like any return, the item must be **shipped back first** (free prepaid label). The refund is issued once the warehouse receives it.
- **How the 14 days are counted:** the delivery date is **day 1**. The window ends at 11:59 PM PT on **day 14**. Example: delivered Nov 1, so report by Nov 14.
- Reports after 14 days are handled under the Warranty Policy instead.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Payments & Pricing Policy > 2. Price adjustments
- If an item's price drops within **14 days** of purchase, the customer can request the difference back **once per item**. The difference is refunded right away to the original payment method.
- **How the 14 days are counted:** the purchase date is **day 1**. The window ends at 11:59 PM PT on **day 14**. Example: bought Nov 1, so a price drop on Nov 14 qualifies and a drop on Nov 15 does not.
- Price adjustments **don't apply** to clearance items, flash sales, or competitors' prices.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Returns & Refunds Policy > 3. How refunds work
- For a normal return, support **starts the return** (customer gets a prepaid label). The refund is issued **once the warehouse receives the item**, not during the chat.
- Refunds go back to the **original payment method**. The customer **can't choose** a different method (no switching a card refund to store credit or a gift card). The only exceptions are gift card purchases (below) and sale items bought at 40%+ off (section 4).
- Card refunds take **5–7 business days** after we receive the return.
- **Gift card** purchases are refunded as a **new gift card**, never as cash.
- Original shipping costs are **not refunded**, unless the item was damaged or we sent the wrong item.
- Return shipping is **free for Plus members**. Everyone else pays a **$7.95 return shipping fee**, taken out of the refund.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Returns & Refunds Policy > 4. Sale items
- Items bought at **40% off or more** (but not marked Final Sale) can be returned for **store credit only**, not a refund to the card.
